blocks.text: 40 questions: five from each of the 8 chapters, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 85% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for Grammar in Russian: the Terms. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.

exercises.q: ___ (morphology)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A method of representing a language or the sounds of language by written symbols.

exercises.q: ___ (spelling, orthography)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A set of symbols and marks which are used to clarify meaning in text by separating strings of words into clauses, phrases and sentences.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The set of all words and phrases in a language; any unified subset of words from a particular language.

exercises.q: Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
___ (grammar)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The study of the internal structure of morphemes (words and their semantic building blocks).

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The relative emphasis or prominence given to a certain syllable in a word or to a certain word in a phrase or sentence.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A system of rules and principles for the structure of a language, or of languages in general.

exercises.q: ___ (punctuation)
___ (stress)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The study of the structure of phrases, sentences, and language.

exercises.q: ___ (syntax)
___ (vocabulary, lexis)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A word that modifies a verb, adjective, other …, or various other types of words, phrases, or clauses.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A word used to join other words, phrases, or clauses together into sentences.

exercises.q: ___ (verb)
___ (pronoun)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A part of speech that has no inherent lexical definition but must be associated with another word to impart meaning, often a grammatical category.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A word or a group of words that one may substitute for a noun or noun phrase.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A linguistic category of words sharing syntactic or morphological behaviour and semantic properties, such as noun or verb.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A number word, a simple or compound word for a number often having particular grammatical attributes depending on the language.

exercises.q: ___ (participle)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A participle that modifies a verb in the same sentence and is equivalent to an … clause in English.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Any of a class of non-inflecting words and multiword terms typically employed to connect a following noun or a pronoun, in an adjectival or adverbial sense, with some other word.

exercises.q: ___ (interjection)
Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
___ (verbal adverb, gerund)
___ (part of speech)
___ (preposition)
___ (noun)
___ (adverb)
Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A word that indicates an action, event, or state of being.

exercises.q: ___ (particle)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A word that functions as the name of a specific object or set of objects, such as person, animal, place, word, thing, phenomenon, substance, quality, or idea.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A word that modifies a noun or noun phrase or describes a noun’s referent.

exercises.q: ___ (numeral)
___ (conjunction)
Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A phrase or word with no particular grammatical relation to a sentence but which serves to express emotion or as a filled pause.

exercises.q: ___ (adjective)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A form of a verb that may function as an adjective, noun or adverb.

exercises.q: ___ (prepositional case)
___ (dative case)
___ (accusative case)
___ (case)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A specific inflection of a word (particularly a noun, pronoun, or adjective) depending on its function in the sentence.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The case used to mark the immediate object (direct object) on which the transitive verb acts.

exercises.q: ___ (declension)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A noun case used to express means or agency.

exercises.q: Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The case used to indicate the subject—or agent—of a finite verb.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A way of categorizing nouns, pronouns, or adjectives according to the inflections they receive.

exercises.q: ___ (nominative case)
___ (instrumental case)
Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A noun case serving as object of a preposition.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The grammatical case, chiefly applicable to nouns, used to express a relationship of origin or possession.

exercises.q: ___ (genitive case)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Case used to express direction towards an indirect object, the recipient or beneficiary of an action.

topics.title: Gender, number, animacy; the parts of a word

exercises.q: ___ (prefix)
___ (singular)
___ (stem)
Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A morpheme added to the beginning of a word to modify its meaning.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The characteristic of a noun, dependent on its living or sentient nature, which affects grammatical features.

exercises.q: ___ (animacy)
___ (gender)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Of, pertaining or belonging to the male grammatical gender, in languages that have gender distinctions.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The last morpheme of a word, added to some base to make an inflected form (such as -s in "dogs").

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A morpheme added at the end of a word to modify the word's meaning.

exercises.q: ___ (masculine gender)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The main part of an uninflected word to which affixes may be added to form inflections of the word.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Of a word or phrase, the state of being …, dual or …, shown by inflection.

exercises.q: Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A word in the form in which it potentially refers to something other than one person or thing.

exercises.q: ___ (ending)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A division of nouns and pronouns (and sometimes of other parts of speech) into masculine or feminine, and sometimes other categories like neuter or common, and animate or inanimate.

exercises.q: Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
___ (root)
___ (number: singular or plural)
___ (suffix)
___ (feminine gender)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The primary lexical unit of a word, which carries the most significant aspects of semantic content and cannot be reduced into smaller constituents.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A form of a word that refers to only one person or thing.

exercises.q: ___ (neuter gender)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Of, pertaining or belonging to the female grammatical gender, in languages that have gender distinctions.

exercises.q: ___ (plural)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Having a form which is not masculine nor feminine.

topics.title: The verb: aspect, tense, person, mood, voice

exercises.q: ___ (tense)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A verb that is accompanied (either clearly or implicitly) by a direct object in the active voice.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The form in which the subject of a verb carries out some action.

exercises.q: Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Mood expressing an action or state which is hypothetical or anticipated rather than actual, including wishes and commands.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The form of a transitive verb in which its subject receives the action.

exercises.q: ___ (imperfective aspect)
___ (perfective aspect)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The mood of a verb used in ordinary, factual, or objective statements.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A grammatical … that describes an action viewed as a simple whole.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The grammatical mood generally expressing a command, though also used to express a request or permission.

exercises.q: ___ (future tense)
___ (mood)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The tense or time form of a verb used to refer to an event or occurrence that has not yet happened or is expected to happen in the ….

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A particular way of inflecting or conjugating verbs, or a particular form of a verb, which indicates the relation of the subject of the verb to the action which the verb expresses.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A grammatical category that expresses how a verbal action, event, or state, extends over time.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A grammatical … used for ongoing, habitual, repeated, or similar semantic roles, whether they are in the past, present, or future.

exercises.q: ___ (past tense)
___ (subjunctive or conditional mood)
___ (imperative mood)
___ (conjugation)
___ (aspect)
___ (infinitive)
___ (indicative mood)
___ (person: 1st, 2nd, 3rd)
___ (active voice)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The property of indicating the point in time at which an action or state of being occurs or exists.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A linguistic category used to distinguish between the speaker of an utterance and those to whom or about whom they are speaking.

exercises.q: ___ (transitive verb)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A verb whose subject and direct object are the same.

topics.title: The adjective: degrees of comparison, the short form

exercises.q: Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A form of an adjective that indicates a different … of the attribute the adjective denotes; like the positive, comparative and superlative forms.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The degree of comparison of an adjective or adverb used when comparing two entities in terms of a certain property or a certain way of doing something.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: Particularly in Slavic languages, a … form of the …, used predicatively.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The degree of comparison of an adjective or adverb used when comparing three or more entities in terms of a certain property or a certain way of doing something.

exercises.q: ___ (short form of an adjective)
___ (comparative)
___ (degree of comparison)
___ (superlative)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The noun phrase which is an internal complement of a verb phrase or a prepositional phrase. In a verb phrase with a transitive action verb, it is typically the receiver of the action.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A grammatically complete series of words consisting of a subject and predicate, even if one or the other is implied.

exercises.q: ___ (word group, phrase)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A word or, more commonly, a … of words that functions as a single unit in the syntax of a sentence.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A word that qualifies a noun.

exercises.q: ___ (object)
___ (adverbial)
Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
___ (attribute, modifier)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The noun, pronoun or noun phrase about whom the statement is made.

exercises.q: ___ (subject)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A word or a group of words that modifies or more closely defines the sentence or the verb.

exercises.q: ___ (sentence)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The part of the sentence (or clause) which states a property that a subject has or is characterized by.

exercises.q: ___ (predicate)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A unit of human speech which often forms words corresponding to one opening of the mouth; a vowel and its surrounding consonants.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The Cyrillic letter Ь/ь, which in modern languages using the Cyrillic alphabet serves to denote a … (palatized) consonant.

exercises.q: Match each term to its English. Drag a term onto its meaning, or tap one and then the other.
___ (alphabet)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A symbol in an alphabet.

exercises.q: ___ (hard sign, ъ)
___ (vowel)
___ (letter)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A sound that results from the passage of air through restrictions of the oral cavity.

exercises.q: ___ (consonant)
___ (soft sign, ь)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The set of letters used when writing in a language.

exercises.q: Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: The Cyrillic letter Ъ/ъ, which in modern languages serves to denote a … (non-palatalized) consonant.

exercises.q: ___ (syllable)
Which term is this the definition of?
exercises.ru: A sound produced by the vocal cords with relatively little restriction of the oral cavity, forming the prominent sound of a syllable.
